subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add an opt-in mode to ingest every Space message, and should that mode use Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, user OAuth, app authentication with admin approval, or remain unsupported for now?
rationale: The remaining request changes which Google Chat messages can reach OpenClaw, which credentials and scopes are stored, and how subscriptions are provisioned, so automation should not choose the privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, consent, subscription lifecycle, allowlists, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as @mention/webhook-only for now and close or narrow this issue only after maintainers explicitly reject broader Space visibility.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Let focused thread/session fixes proceed separately while tracking all-message ingestion in a dedicated product/security design item.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, consent, subscription lifecycle, allowlists, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest routing signal from the thread-support merge, prior review context, and adjacent Google Chat auth/API history.
